visual.general_description: A scanned 12-lead electrocardiogram strip on red grid paper. The printed header carries a paper-brand line, an identifier line, an empty name label and a date and time stamp. Lead labels I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF and V1 to V6 are printed in four columns of three leads, with calibration pulses at the left. The footer prints recording settings (25 mm/s, 10 mm/mV, filter settings, a QTc method label), an institution name, a software version string and a device serial number.
visual.detailed_description: The strip is a wide landscape scan of thermal-style pink paper with a fine red grid. Three rows by four columns of tracings are labelled I, II, III; aVR, aVL, aVF; V1, V2, V3; V4, V5, V6, each showing several beats. Rectangular calibration pulses sit at the left of leads I, II and III. Waveform amplitude and morphology differ across leads; the right-most column of leads is cut off at the paper edge. The header and footer text categories are a paper brand, an identifier, a date and time stamp, an institution name, a device serial number and device software string; their values are not reproduced here.
